title: Receipt-based sales
html:
Below a value limit of HUF 900,000 including VAT, if the buyer is not a taxable person and does not request an invoice, the business is obliged to issue a receipt. The receipt can only be issued on paper, in Hungarian.

The receipt must contain: the date of issue, its serial number, the tax number, name and address of the issuer, and the consideration of the product or service including tax.

The product can be selected by scanning a barcode or by typing the name or item number manually. The product can also be selected from a drop-down window. An item-level discount, a percentage or fixed-amount discount on the total, or an individual price can be given.

To correct, click the orange pencil button; to delete, the Remove items button. For mixed payment, add every payment instrument with the + sign. If the Amount and the Payments match, the transaction can be closed.

⚠ Caution

Before pressing the Paid button, the customer must in all cases have settled the purchase financially.

Printing the receipt also produces the warehouse issue and the cash receipt document at the same time.

With a loyalty programme, enter the loyalty card number before saving the receipt. If the card number is incorrect or expired, Infinity displays a warning.
